newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish currency reserves rise to $17.7 bln in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Polish currency reserves rise to $17.7 bln in Oct.

text.p: Polish official foreign currency reserves, those held by the state, grew by $146 million in October to $17.70 billion and were $3.48 billion higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
The central bank said official reserves grew $2.74 billion in the January-October period compared to a $8.19 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH CURRENCY RESERVES OCTOBER SEPTEMBER OCT 95
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
